target: acceptances 3+7 — hardened must fail loudly when the payload marker is absent, never fall back to standard
cmd: o=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" profile "$FIXTURES/profile/hardened.md" 2>&1); c=$?; n=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -ci "hardened review payload is not installed"); s=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -c "005"); f=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -cx "standard"); printf '{"c":%s,"msg":%s,"names005":%s,"fellback":%s}' "$c" "$n" "$s" "$f"
